Product RFEs should be filed in Jira (`CM` / `OAPE`) or as an
[OpenShift enhancement](https://github.com/openshift/enhancements). Use this
GitHub template only for repo-local discussion.

## Problem Statement

What does the operator not do today that you need (CR, operand, OLM, CI)?

## Proposed Solution

What should change in this repository?

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches, including existing CertManager / IstioCSR / TrustManager fields.

## Additional Context

Related Jira, enhancement, or ADR (`docs/adr/`).
